news.headline: Urban Company Q2 Results: Loss widens to Rs 182 crore; revenue jumps 41% YoY
news.summary: Urban Company reported a net loss of Rs 182 crore in Q2FY27 as investments in its quick services business, InstaHelp, weighed on profitability. Revenue rose 41% year-on-year to Rs 537 crore, while orders grew 103%. The company also approved a fresh capital raise of up to Rs 2,500 crore, subject to shareholder approval.

news.headline: HDFC Bank Q2 results preview: PAT, NII may rise up to 9% YoY; deposit growth in focus
news.summary: HDFC Bank is set to unveil its Q2 results on October 17, 2026, showcasing key financial indicators. Analysts predict a year-on-year rise in net interest income of about 8%, driven by an increase in loans. Profit after tax forecasts vary among brokerages, reflecting a range of expectations regarding the bank's financial health.

news.headline: ICICI Bank Q2 Results Preview: PAT, NII may rise up to 21% YoY; margins, deposit growth in focus
news.summary: ICICI Bank is expected to report 15.8-18% year-on-year growth in net interest income and 15-21% growth in profit after tax in Q2FY27, according to brokerage estimates. Investors will track net interest margins, loan and deposit growth, operating profitability and asset quality, with margin pressure and provisioning trends remaining key monitorables.

news.headline: Mukesh Ambani taps massive Reliance workforce to boost Jio’s record IPO
news.summary: Mukesh Ambani is mobilising Reliance Industries’ workforce to boost interest in Jio Platforms’ record IPO. The conglomerate has encouraged employees to consider investing, released October salaries early and set aside shares for eligible employees and Reliance shareholders.

news.headline: Persistent Systems shares slide 5% despite Q2 revenue growth. Buy, sell or hold?
news.summary: Persistent Systems shares fell 5% despite 7.8% sequential constant-currency revenue growth in Q2FY27, as margin contraction and a sharp decline in profit weighed on sentiment. Brokerages remained divided on the stock amid valuation concerns and acquisition-related costs.

news.headline: Kotak Mahindra Bank among 5 stocks that hit 52-week highs & rallied up to 15% in a month
news.summary: Five BSE 500 stocks—Shyam Metalics, PVR Inox, Kotak Mahindra Bank, Indian Hotels and Laurus Labs—hit fresh 52-week highs as the Sensex gained 413 points. All five stocks posted monthly gains of around 8% to 15%, signalling positive momentum.

news.headline: Yes Bank Q2 preview: Will strong profit, NII growth offer relief for investors amid AT-1 bond saga?
news.summary: Yes Bank is expected to post a 48% YoY jump in Q2 net profit to Rs 969 crore, driven by robust loan growth and higher NII. However, investor focus remains on the Supreme Court ruling invalidating its Rs 8,415 crore AT-1 bond write-off, which has pressured the stock.

news.headline: Indian bonds hang tight ahead of supply
news.summary: Indian government bonds remained stable on Friday as traders contemplated the central bank's forthcoming policy moves. A noteworthy auction of 10-year bonds is on the horizon, anticipated to shed light on market demand and interest. Recent shifts in US Treasury yields have bolstered the Indian market. The Reserve Bank of India is fine-tuning financial conditions to cope with capital outflows and escalating shorting costs of the rupee.

news.headline: BoE's Bailey says energy price pass-through remains limited, rate risks persist
news.summary: Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey said rising energy prices have had limited broader inflationary effects so far, but warned that second-round pressures remain uncertain. With inflation at 3.1%, above the 2% target, policymakers are weighing potential interest rate hikes against economic resilience, rising borrowing costs and geopolitical uncertainty.

news.headline: US Market: Fed's Goolsbee says latest US inflation data is discouraging
news.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago President Austan Goolsbee called the latest US consumer and producer inflation data discouraging, raising concerns about persistent price pressures. While temporary factors such as tariffs and geopolitical conflicts could ease, he warned that demand driven by the rapid expansion of AI data centres could require a policy response.

news.headline: Persistent Systems among 4 F&O stocks with a sharp rise in futures open interest
news.summary: Persistent Systems, Ujjivan Small Finance Bank, Siemens Energy India, and Nestle India recorded futures open interest increases exceeding 11% on October 15, indicating heightened derivatives market activity.

news.headline: Will Ambani's all-fresh Jio sale prove to be a masterstroke for investors?
news.summary: Reliance Jio is set to roll out an ambitious Rs 30,213 crore IPO featuring solely new equity shares, not existing ones. In light of mixed results from recent Indian IPOs, this move aims to cut down Jio's debt while bolstering its financial standing. The company's IPO, valued at Rs 10.

news.headline: NSE, BSE, Groww, other capital market stocks rise up to 3% as Sebi revises CAS framework. What traders must know
news.summary: SEBI has revised the Closing Auction Session framework, changing market timings, order transfer rules and settlement price calculations for derivatives. The updated rules will take effect from December 7, 2026, with provisions for transferring unexecuted limit and iceberg orders kicking in on February 8, 2027.

news.headline: Aggressive RBI measures hand India bonds a ninth weekly loss
news.summary: Indian government bonds have experienced ongoing losses for nine consecutive weeks due to RBI's monetary tightening measures. The benchmark 6.94% 2036 bond yield has climbed over 62 basis points during this period, reflecting investor concerns. Additionally, the RBI's commitment to support the rupee and manage liquidity has further dampened bond market sentiment. Market participants are wary of possible future actions regarding bond yields as the RBI addresses financial stability.

news.headline: LTM Q2 Results: PAT remains flat at Rs 1,380 crore; revenue rises 14% YoY; co declares Rs 25 per share dividend
news.summary: LTM reported a marginal 0.1% decline in Q2 FY27 profit to Rs 1,379.9 crore, while revenue rose 13.6% to Rs 11,807.6 crore. Enterprise AI and Business AI revenue grew 47%, and the company declared an interim dividend of Rs 25.
